evidence: To explore the role of the influenza virus PA protein in regulating host biological processes, we performed immunoprecipitation and LC‒MS/MS to globally identify cellular factors that interact with the PA proteins of the influenza A H1N1, 2009 pandemic H1N1, and H3N2 viruses.
293T cells were transfected with these plasmids, and the FLAG-tagged proteins were immunoprecipitated with anti-FLAG resin.

The plasmids expressing the PA protein were constructed from the PA open reading frames of the PR8/H1N1, A/Taiwan/126/2009/H1N1 (pdmH1N1), and A/Udorn/72/H3N2 (Ud/H3N2) influenza A viruses in pcDNA3 vectors.
